reviewDecisions.rationale: Magnitude and persistence were repeatedly upgraded, but all specialist observations share one origin; deep research must independently verify company-level earnings and expectation burden.
Lead-time and price changes are economically material and distinct from memory, but the event has one independent origin and requires verification before any high-priority hypothesis.
Two independent first-party companies confirm continued power/electrification order strength; deep research must test whether any A-share edge remains after Q4 saturation.

Storage demand, raw-material rebound and export disruption are real, but March price reversal/weak EV demand make the causal winner ambiguous; this is exactly a deep-research case rather than a directional commodity signal.
Multiple independent physical disruptions and rapid urea price increases create a falsifiable fertilizer economics event.
Freight prices and vessel scarcity are quantitatively extreme; company mapping must verify vessel class/spot exposure and shock duration.
Enforcement and non-China supply scarcity are independently visible, but deep research must separate upstream beneficiaries from downstream exporters harmed by controls.
Record futures price is not accepted as a supply-demand opportunity when physical China demand is weak and inventories are high; this is a deliberate negative-control event.
Official data are useful context, but broad state/equipment growth does not define a sufficiently narrow expectation gap for company mapping.
